logline: 생명의 경계를 넘어 보려는 젊은 학생이, 밤새 붙들고 있던 것이 눈을 뜨자 방을 뛰쳐나간다.
destination: 다락 실험대 — 그가 다시 돌아와 확인해야 하는 자리
protagonist: 잉골슈타트에서 홀로 연구하는 스무 살 학생
setting: 18세기 말 독일 대학 도시의 다락 실험실과 묘지
anchor: a hollow-eyed young student in a stained linen shirt and dark waistcoat, unkempt hair
palette: sickly candle yellow, storm-lightning white, deep bottle green, cold stone grey

beats.beat: 젊은 학생이 밤마다 다락 등불을 켠다.
beats.visual: a young student lighting an oil lamp in a cluttered attic laboratory of glass jars and copper coils
beats.motion: the wick catches and flares, glass jars glint, shadows swing across the beams

beats.beat: 그는 묘지와 도살장을 돌며 재료를 모은다.
beats.visual: a young student with a covered basket walking between leaning gravestones under a low moon
beats.motion: his lantern swings low, fog rolls between stones, the basket cloth lifts

beats.beat: 다락 실험대 위에 거대한 형체가 눕혀진다.
beats.visual: a very tall covered figure laid out on a long workbench, copper wires running to jars around it
beats.motion: the sheet settles over the shape, wires hum, lamplight crawls along the bench

beats.beat: 폭풍우 치는 밤 그가 마지막 손잡이를 당긴다.
beats.visual: a young student pulling a brass lever as lightning fills an attic window, apparatus sparking
beats.motion: lightning floods the window, sparks leap along the coils, his hair lifts

beats.visual: a very large hand on a workbench with fingers beginning to curl, sheet slipping from the wrist
beats.motion: the fingers curl one by one, the sheet slides off, lamplight shivers

beats.visual: a young student bolting through an attic doorway, overturned stool behind him, bench in deep shadow
beats.motion: the stool topples, his coat flies back, the door bangs against the wall

beats.beat: 그것이 그를 다시 찾아온다면 무엇을 요구할까?
beats.visual: a huge shadow stretching across a snowy mountain slope toward a small distant figure below
beats.motion: the shadow lengthens across the snow, wind scours the ridge, the figure turns

beats.visual: two lines of footprints crossing an empty snowfield toward a pale horizon, wind-scoured drifts
beats.motion: wind lifts snow across the tracks, the far horizon whitens, drifts shift

withheld: 피조물이 가족을 앗아 가고 북극까지 쫓고 쫓기는 마지막
